args: file="$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH"; case "$file" in *.py) cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/backend" && uv run ruff check --fix "$file" && uv run ruff format "$file" ;; *.ts|*.tsx|*.css|*.json) cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/frontend" && ./node_modules/.bin/prettier --write "$file" && ./node_modules/.bin/eslint --fix "$file" ;; esac
